offer.name: Booked & Branded

offer.promise: Own the branded front door, keep the booking tool that works today, and add deeper operations only when the upgrade earns its place.
offer.payment_boundary: FAMtastic displays an owner-approved Cash App or existing payment QR but does not process, receive, settle, or reconcile payments.

portable_patterns: Optional bilingual service copy when the real owner and audience support it

templates.name: Crown Ledger
templates.archetype: precision barber with a busy repeat-client chair
templates.thesis: Precision should read before the first service card does.
templates.headline: A sharper front door for every chair.
templates.subhead: An editorial service ledger, confident proof of craft, and a direct path to the calendar the owner already trusts.
templates.shape: calibration marks, cropped circles, hard rules, and one softened booking seal
templates.type: compressed uppercase impact, serif editorial interruption, and tabular service facts
templates.motion: one clipped entrance and a slow calibration-line sweep; fully disabled under reduced motion
templates.booking_label: Keep Booksy for discovery. Make the branded site the repeat-client home.
templates.booking_note: Current-provider link, Square widget, Google appointment page, Cal.com, or request-to-book can occupy the same booking slot after owner review.

services.name: Signature Cut
services.prep: Arrive with hair free of heavy product

facts: Services, preparation, policy, contact, hours, and map
Owner-controlled booking handoff and payment QR

templates.name: Coil Ritual
templates.archetype: texture-specialist hair studio centered on consultation and care
templates.thesis: Care becomes premium when the process is visible.
templates.headline: Your texture deserves a plan, not a guess.
templates.subhead: A tactile consultation journey that makes care, preparation, timing, and the next appointment feel considered.
templates.shape: nested curves, strand paths, soft cutouts, and consultation cards that overlap like swatches
templates.type: large lyrical serif phrases held by practical sans-serif labels and restrained measures
templates.motion: slow strand-path tracing and a single soft image reveal; no looping essential content
templates.booking_label: Use the marketplace for discovery; use the studio site to teach, prepare, and welcome the return visit.
templates.booking_note: The starter can keep the present provider while the owner tests a clearer direct path without an overnight migration.
facts: Preparation and care notes before booking
Optional consultation intake and future care-plan upgrades

templates.name: Barrio Signal
templates.archetype: bilingual neighborhood barber brand with high mobile and walk-in traffic
templates.thesis: The neighborhood should recognize the signal in one scroll.
templates.headline: Tu estilo. Your chair. One clear next move.
templates.subhead: A bilingual, mobile-first rhythm with service clarity, real location context, and booking that does not force a platform switch.
templates.shape: tile modules, registration marks, diagonal appointment ribbons, and hard-working utility chips
templates.type: oversized campaign sans, condensed utility labels, and bilingual lines with equal visual dignity
templates.motion: short poster-slide transitions and a controlled marquee that stops on interaction and under reduced motion
templates.booking_label: Discovery can stay on Booksy. The owner gains a memorable home to share, measure, and grow.
templates.booking_note: Language, services, neighborhood references, and imagery require owner confirmation; the template never infers culture from a name or ZIP code.
facts: Click-to-call, click-to-text, social, hours, and map
Current booking link plus future direct path
QR-ready share card for the chair, mirror, or business card

templates.name: Salt Glass
templates.archetype: consultation-led hair color studio with transformation and maintenance services
templates.thesis: Luxury is a clear plan carried through beautiful light.
templates.headline: Color that knows what happens after the reveal.
templates.subhead: An airy editorial system that moves from inspiration to consultation, maintenance, and the right booking path.
templates.shape: translucent planes, long shoreline curves, prismatic crops, and disciplined consultation grids
templates.type: high-contrast editorial serif, razor-clean sans-serif facts, and one oversized chromatic word per viewport
templates.motion: light refraction drift and one before-to-plan reveal; no auto-playing comparison slider
templates.booking_label: A branded consultation path can pre-qualify the service while the current calendar remains connected.
templates.booking_note: The site can route color corrections, first visits, and maintenance differently without pretending to diagnose or quote a final price online.
facts: Contact, location, hours, domain, forwarding email, booking, and QR foundation
